text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Hardship striking right in the middle of our studies...
I sense a malevolent will at work...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It must be terribly inconvenient for you
if I were to cross over to another world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: To think you believed something of this level could stop me. You have grossly underestimated me, Saint Red Desire.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Let us offer our prayers to the heavens.
And with the blessing of light, dispel the dark reach of evil!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Desire-san!
Class is in session, please be quiet.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I see, you've taken advantage of this situation where I cannot pray...
However, I am a saintess!
I shall endure this much without—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With even prayer sealed away, they were tormented for a time by a wicked will—
or rather, a splitting headache.
